title.en: Mazda built a petrol engine that ignites like a diesel 🤯 #shorts
title.id: Mazda bikin mesin bensin yang nyala kayak diesel 🤯 #shorts

description.en: Mazda's Skyactiv-X squeezes a lean petrol mix to about 16:1. A small spark flame raises the pressure and the rest of the mix ignites by compression, like a diesel. Mazda calls it SPCCI, Spark Controlled Compression Ignition.
description.id: Skyactiv-X dari Mazda memampatkan campuran bensin yang irit sampai sekitar 16:1. Percikan busi bikin api kecil, tekanannya naik, lalu sisa campurannya menyala sendiri karena kompresi, kayak diesel. Mazda menyebutnya SPCCI.

scenes.en: Mazda built a petrol engine that lights its fuel *like a diesel*.
scenes.id: Mazda bikin mesin bensin yang nyalain bahan bakarnya *kayak diesel*.

scenes.en: A normal petrol engine needs a *spark* to burn the fuel. A diesel needs none: it squeezes air until it's hot enough to *ignite by itself*.
scenes.id: Mesin bensin biasa butuh *percikan busi*. Diesel nggak: udaranya dipadatkan sampai cukup panas buat *menyala sendiri*.

scenes.en: The Skyactiv-X squeezes a *lean* petrol mix to about *16 to 1*, close to diesel territory.
scenes.id: Skyactiv-X memadatkan campuran bensin yang *irit* sampai sekitar *16 banding 1*, hampir kayak diesel.

scenes.en: Then a tiny spark lights a *small flame*. The pressure jumps, and the rest of the mix *ignites at once*.
scenes.id: Lalu busi bikin *api kecil*. Tekanannya melonjak, dan sisa campurannya *menyala bersamaan*.

scenes.en: Mazda calls it *SPCCI*, and claims up to *20 percent* better fuel economy than its regular petrol engine.
scenes.id: Mazda menyebutnya *SPCCI*, dan mengklaim irit bensin sampai *20 persen* dibanding mesin bensin biasanya.

scenes.en: On a cold start or under heavy load, it simply switches back to *normal spark ignition*.
scenes.id: Pas mesin dingin atau beban berat, mesinnya balik ke *pengapian busi biasa*.

scenes.en: Petrol that burns like diesel: *genius*, or *too complicated*?
scenes.id: Bensin yang nyala kayak diesel: *jenius* atau *kerumitan*?
